verdict.rationale: Parsec's docs show a host can let a guest either observe or take control, and can limit which apps guests may see and interact with. That covers the view-only versus control part of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows per-connection scoping of clipboard sharing or file access, which is half of what the story asks for. Missing for 10: clipboard permission scoping, file-access permission scoping, detailed docs on the permission controls, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, I can scope what a connected device may do: view only, control, clipboard, or file access

citations.quote: share a link, and a team member can observe or even take control of your computer.
The host can control exactly which apps connected guests are approved to see and interact with
